analysis.reasonEn: RSI exited oversold but remains in neutral territory at 45.1. MACD histogram shows improvement but not yet a confirmed bullish expansion. analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($65.56) vs SMA5 ($63.96)/SMA20 ($66.59)/SMA50 ($71.36): short-term bullish, mid-term bearish position, below SMA20
· Significantly lower compared to SMA100 ($72.94)/SMA200 ($81.14): mid-to-long term trend weakening
· 52-week position 7.5%: recovery phase from historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (30.5 → 45.1): exited oversold, entered neutral zone, weak upward momentum
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.6008 → 0.2330): improving but still in bearish convergence, weak trend reversal signal
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $66.59): hovering near mid-band, narrowing band width
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($65.08): based on pivot support, near current price
· Swing resistance ($73.07): based on 20-day high, potential for upward reversal upon breakout
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low): recovery signal, suggesting potential trend reversal
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio 1.10: normal level, moderate confidence in movement
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): short-term rebound attempt, need to confirm 20-day line resistance
